name: Experimental Mixed Media
description: Off-white base broken by hot magenta, acid yellow and green; collided photographic, illustrated and typographic layers with deliberate roughness.

tokens.texture: Photocopy grain, misregistration offsets, torn edges
tokens.spacing: --u = 1% of short side; --gap; safe-area insets per format

motion.personality: Abrupt and tactile: stepped timing, jump cuts, glitchy offsets
motion.notes: Use on-twos stepping and hard cuts on motion; keep one element legible at all times.

contrast_checked: accent/paper is below 4.5:1: use for display type 24px+ equivalent, shapes and rules only; never for body or caption text

validation.evidence: Contrast ratios computed from the stylesheet hex values with src/pipeline/colorscience.py (WCAG 2.x), 2026-11-02. Not yet used in a rendered project.
